steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each record is placed by whether it is complete and whether its fix was checked.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 action closed without an effectiveness check

findings.title: Action closed with no effectiveness check
findings.fix: Check the fix works, then close

findings.title: Containment not in place before the cause was known
findings.fix: Record the containment and its date

findings.title: Audit finding with no root cause

outcome.notChecked: whether the containment works; whether the root cause is the true one; whether the action has been done; sector standards such as IATF 16949 or AS9100, which this method does not cover; records that were never made.
